title: From San Diego Temecula Wine Country Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the best wines of the San Diego area without worrying about a designated driver on this tour through Temecula Wine Country. Visit three local wineries to taste their finest vintages while learning how the region’s unique microclimates influence flavor and tasting notes. At one winery, enjoy a behind-the-scenes tour to deepen your understanding of winemaking and enhance your tasting experience.
